controleDeCaixa.theAmountToApproveIs: . The amount to approve is the counted one.
controleDeCaixa.postedAsACashShortage: Posted as a cash shortage, under the name of whoever operated the register.
controleDeCaixa.withinToleranceRecordedNotPosted: Within tolerance: recorded, not posted as a shortage.
controleDeCaixa.provisionedOrAwaitingApprovalNot: provisioned or awaiting approval: not included in the balance
controleDeCaixa.postedLaterDatedOnA: posted later, dated on a day that is already closed
controleDeCaixa.theOpeningIsTheBalance: The opening is the balance this account's previous register closed with.
controleDeCaixa.onlyAccountsWithRegisterControl: Only accounts with register control appear. Free accounts receive and pay without opening a register.
controleDeCaixa.registerForToCorrectAn: Register for {date}. To correct an entry, it's better to reverse it: the adjustment is for what has no source entry.
controleDeCaixa.eGChangeCarriedOver: E.g.: change carried over from yesterday's register

Check the day’s entries and correct them; if the money really exists, post an inflow adjustment with the reason.
controleDeCaixa.theDayAcceptsEntriesAgain: The day accepts entries again and the check made at closing is undone: it will need to be checked and closed again.
controleDeCaixa.eGTheDayS: E.g.: the day's receipt was posted to the wrong account

controleDeCaixa.leavesOneAccountAndEnters: Leaves one account and enters the other in the same entry. It is not income or an expense: it does not affect the result.
controleDeCaixa.reachesTheDestinationTheFee: {valor} reaches the destination; the fee is posted to card fees.

frenteDeCaixa.theSaleLeavesTheRegister: {total} · the sale leaves the register and goes to cash flow, under the customer's name.
frenteDeCaixa.onlyCustomersWithAnApproved: Only customers with an approved record that is cleared for the chosen method can be billed. A pre-registration can't be billed: complete the record in Records first.
frenteDeCaixa.cashControlWasTurnedOn: Cash control was turned on for the {controlEnabled} account: closing cash is checked in the day's register
frenteDeCaixa.theOpeningBalanceIsThe: The opening balance is the change already in the drawer. It is included in the closing count.
frenteDeCaixa.moneyMovingBetweenTheDrawer: Money moving between the drawer and a company account. It is neither income nor expense.
frenteDeCaixa.eGAboveTheCash: E.g.: above the cash limit in the drawer
frenteDeCaixa.openedByOnAndLeft: Opened by {operator} on {valor} and left open. Enter the justification; the difference is recorded under the name of whoever was operating it.
frenteDeCaixa.countTheCashInThe: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the total. The expected amount only appears afterward.
frenteDeCaixa.checkTheCashInThe: Check the cash in the drawer: confirm the counted amount or correct it if it differs.
frenteDeCaixa.staysInTheDrawerFor: Stays in the drawer for tomorrow
frenteDeCaixa.billedByTheRegisterTo: Billed by the register to the customer
frenteDeCaixa.theyCameInAsQuick: They came in as quick sales and were billed by the register. They don't enter the register or the count: they are already in cash flow as receivables. They leave here at closing and stay in the daily report.
frenteDeCaixa.closingPostsToTheMain: Closing posts to the main register's accounts
frenteDeCaixa.theCustomerHasAlreadyPaid: The customer has already paid {paid}. The refund goes back through the methods the money came in by and is recorded with the justification and who made it.
frenteDeCaixa.theSaleLeavesTheRegister2: The sale leaves the register queue and the work order is canceled. The cancellation is recorded.
frenteDeCaixa.theSaleLeavesTheQueue: The sale leaves the queue and the quote is marked as rejected, with the work order cancelled. Nothing was received, so there is no refund.
frenteDeCaixa.theSaleIsClosedAnd: . The sale is closed and what was not paid,
frenteDeCaixa.isRecordedAsALoss: , is recorded as a loss. The deposit already received stays and offsets the loss.
frenteDeCaixa.eGTheCustomerHasn: E.g.: the customer hasn't answered calls since August
frenteDeCaixa.whoDiscardedItWhenAnd: Who discarded it, when and why is recorded.
frenteDeCaixa.eachPointOfSaleHas: Each point of sale has its own closing check, shortage tolerance, counter rounding and drawer.
frenteDeCaixa.differenceShownButNotPosted: Difference shown but not posted as a shortage
frenteDeCaixa.asAPercentageOfThe: As a percentage of the sale
frenteDeCaixa.whenTheOperatorDoesnT: When the operator doesn't choose the account, PIX and card payments at this point of sale go to these accounts and, without them, to the method's default in Bank accounts.
frenteDeCaixa.registerDrawerGoesToThe: Register drawer · goes to the Cash account at closing
frenteDeCaixa.moveTheRemainingAmountTo: Move the remaining amount to this method
frenteDeCaixa.recordedRightAwayAsA: Recorded right away as a discount, up to {roundingLimit}. It does not create a cash difference.
frenteDeCaixa.theWorkdayEndsAtClose: The workday ends at {workdayEnd}: close the register before you leave. If it stays open, it can't take payments or post anything tomorrow.
frenteDeCaixa.closeItCountingTheDrawer: Close it, counting the drawer, to receive again: nothing is recorded the next day while the previous register is open.
frenteDeCaixa.openTheRegisterToStart: Open the register to start taking payments. The opening balance is the change already in the drawer.
frenteDeCaixa.cameInAsQuickSales: — came in as quick sales and the register set the customer and method. They are already in cash flow and
frenteDeCaixa.doNotCountTowardThe: do not count toward the register balance
frenteDeCaixa.approvedSalesShowUpHere: Approved sales show up here as soon as the salesperson approves them
frenteDeCaixa.theCardGoesInAt: The card goes in at the
frenteDeCaixa.atClosingItGoesTo: ; at closing it goes to the processor, and the fee only appears at settlement. Register totals appear at closing.
frenteDeCaixa.jobsThatAreReadyBut: Jobs that are ready but not delivered show up here, with how many days they have been waiting
frenteDeCaixa.aSaleLandsHereWhen: . A sale lands here when the job is ready but not delivered; it leaves when the customer picks it up and pays the rest, or when the company discards it and records the loss, with the deposit offsetting it. There is no deadline in the system.
frenteDeCaixa.uncheckWhenTheCustomerPays: Uncheck when the customer pays the deposit and picks up later: the job goes to the awaiting pickup list.
frenteDeCaixa.theJobIsHeldFor: The job is held for pickup only once the minimum down payment is made. The rest is collected when the customer picks it up.
frenteDeCaixa.downPaymentCoveredTheRest: Down payment covered. The rest is collected at pickup.
frenteDeCaixa.waiveTheDepositOnThis: Waive the deposit on this sale
frenteDeCaixa.toDeliverCollectTheRemainder: To deliver, collect the remainder. If the customer will pick up later, uncheck "Deliver now".
frenteDeCaixa.theReceiptIsIssuedOn: The receipt is issued on request, after the payment is confirmed.
frenteDeCaixa.theBrowserBlockedTheReceipt: The browser blocked the receipt window.
frenteDeCaixa.onA4TwoCopiesPrint: On A4 two copies print on the same sheet, one for the customer and one for the company, with the cut line in the middle. On the thermal printer the customer copy prints, 80 mm wide.
